Match the first breadcrumb row of the composite shell header to the one-row Flow header; preserve the complete inbox/Pulse header owner.
fixtureChanges: Include all eight captured recent chats and their relative ages behind shell overlays.
Initialize Workspace and Your teams as collapsed for the collapsed-sidebar fixture and assert both states before measurement.
Use the repaired PIC-3 route for toast and tooltip fixtures, with API identifier translation back to owned records.
Keep board card order and team glyph names consistent with the captured data; team colors were sampled from the immutable reference PNG.

remaining.detail: The welcome host needs an owner-approved introductory-video asset. The existing unavailable state remains a finding, with low body-match coverage.

Captured icon/count metadata pills and the Todo header value of 9 differ from the three-card fixture. The captures omit the original metadata payload and complete issue projection; their exact state cannot be reconstructed without assumptions about unrecorded entities.
The original sidebar includes a third team and cycle entries. The isolated fixture has two teams and lacks the original cycle/membership data; its complete resource tree is not equivalent.

The captured Try section offers Import issues; Flow currently offers Invite people, Cycles and Connect GitHub. Choosing the reference onboarding suggestions or the existing task-based onboarding model requires a product decision.

A separate 390px probe found the existing cascading snooze submenu at x=-172.64px. Phone rules are unchanged; choosing a responsive cascading menu or a single-layer interaction remains outside the desktop change. The compact phone read action and existing phone list/action gates pass.
